The list_refunds() tool returned an empty list, which does not match the refunds Alpha Co reported: [{'order_id': 292, 'amount_cents': 2929}, {'order_id': 294, 'amount_cents': 10248}, {'order_id': 295, 'amount_cents': 9055}]. Since the reported refunds do not match the system's records, I must place a hold on the batch for human review.
